BEFORE WE KNOCK

A few useful answers.

Do you charge if it cannot be fixed?

The concept diagnostic-only fee is £49. A repair quote is agreed separately.

How quickly can you come?

Call to check current availability. This static page has no live appointment slots.

Can you fit parts I bought?

Ask first. The concept guarantee would cover labour only on customer-supplied parts.

What about manufacturer warranties?

Check existing manufacturer cover before arranging independent work.

Integrated appliances?

Discuss access, removal and refitting requirements when enquiring.

How do I pay?

The brief lists card, cash and bank transfer after repair. No payment is collected here.
